'''Ceiling Leaves''' are [[furniture]] items that can be purchased for {{Price|400}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Luau]] and [[Flower Dance]]. There are 5 different variants, 2 of which are sold at the [[Flower Dance]] and 3 of which are sold at the [[Luau]].

The ones that are sold at the [[Flower Dance]] are: 
<gallery mode=nolines widths="48px">
Ceiling Leaves 5.png
Ceiling Leaves 4.png
</gallery>
The ones that are sold at the [[Luau]] are:
<gallery mode=nolines widths="48px">
Ceiling Leaves 1.png
Ceiling Leaves 2.png
Ceiling Leaves 3.png
</gallery>
All Ceiling Leaves are also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
